{{Quote|I&hellip; I don't know. I was doing the things I ''always'' do after a mission.|Jester, being questioned by Cody and Rex|audio=Jester-THE.flac|<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />}}
'''Jester''' was the name of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who was part of [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Slick/Legends|Slick's]] [[Slick's squad/Legends|unit]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he served in a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-led [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] that was dispatched to [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|liberate]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Alongside his [[Platoon/Legends|unit]], Jester reconnoitered the planet for a strategic ambush site, but the Confederacy thwarted their planned [[Ground warfare/Legends|attack]], forcing them to retreat. After the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] returned to the [[Christophsis Republic base/Legends|Republic base]], Jester cleaned his [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], as he did after every battle. When [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] questioned the members of Slick's platoon to identify a potential Confederate [[Spy/Legends|spy]], Jester was nervous about talking to his [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officers]], but fellow [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Sketch/Legends|Sketch]] vouched for him, allowing Jester to verify his alibi. [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] Slick himself was thereafter revealed to be the traitor and was apprehended.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I'm sorry, sir. I'm just a little nervous. You're my CO.|Jester, to Rex and Cody|<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />}}
The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] nicknamed Jester<ref name="TCWCE" /> was [[Cloning/Legends|cloned]] from the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] for service in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="DB clone troopers">{{DB|organization|clonetroopers|clone troopers}}</ref> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he joined [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Slick/Legends|Slick's]] [[Slick's squad/Legends|unit]] of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]].<ref name="Official Episode Guide: Season 1" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], in the seventh [[Standard week/Legends|week]] of the war,<ref name="Wild Space">''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''</ref><ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Jester and his [[Platoon/Legends|unit]] were assigned to a contingent of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] Grand [[Army/Legends|Army]]&mdash;under the command of [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]&mdash;to [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|liberate]] the planet [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> After the Republic [[Troop/Legends|troops]] established a [[Christophsis Republic base/Legends|base]], Slick's unit scoured the planet for a suitable site from which to ambush the Confederate [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], eventually locating a [[Christophsis double-towered building/Legends|double-towered business center]]<ref name="Shadowed">''[[The Clone Wars: Shadowed]]''</ref> in [[Chaleydonia/Legends|Crystal City]].<ref name="Art of TCW">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''</ref> On their way back to the Republic base, the platoon came across a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] that were attempting to clear a major boulevard of [[Christophsian/Legends|Christophsian]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]]. When the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] happened upon a crippled Christophsian and contemplated [[Death/Legends|killing]] him, the clones intervened and disabled the enemy troops.<ref name="Shadowed" />

[[File:Jestersalibi.png|thumb|left|230px|Jester presents his freshly scrubbed weapon to Cody.]]
The Republic forces proceeded to the business complex to set up their ambush, and [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] Slick's platoon became based out of the complex's south-facing tower with [[General/Legends|General]] Kenobi and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], while Skywalker and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] stationed their [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] in the parallel north tower. As the Separatist battle droids passed through the plaza below, the approaching column of droids unexpectedly divided in two, and a contingent of droids arrived in the south tower and ambushed the clones. Skywalker and his men [[Grappling hook/Legends|rappelled]] over to the south tower to reinforce Kenobi's forces, and they took a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] to the roof of the tower, where they escaped aboard [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]] [[Hawk/Legends|Hawk's]] [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]].<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />

After returning to the Republic base alongside the others, Jester cleaned his [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], as he always did after a battle. Later that evening, Cody and Rex pinpointed an irregular wavelength in external communications to Slick's [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]], fueling their suspicion that someone in the platoon was a Confederate [[Spy/Legends|spy]]. Consequently, the two [[Officer/Legends|officers]] called Jester and the other members of his platoon back to their quarters to individually interrogate them about their whereabouts earlier that evening. Jester was initially nervous about speaking to his [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officers]], but fellow trooper [[Sketch/Legends|Sketch]] vouched for his habit of regularly cleaning his blaster, and Jester presented his freshly scrubbed weapon to Cody as evidence. Eventually, Slick was revealed to be the spy and escaped from the barracks, following which he [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotaged]] the Republic's [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]], [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE walkers]], and weapons depot. When Gus spotted Slick heading for the base's command center, Rex and Cody ordered Slick's platoon to secure the perimeter. The two officers thereafter managed to detain Slick.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|He cleans his weapon after every mission. First thing, every time. He's kind of obsessed that way.|Sketch, on Jester|audio=Jester2-THE.flac|<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />}}
[[File:Slickssquad.png|thumb|right|250px|Jester and his brethren discover Slick's treachery.]]
As a Human [[Gender/Legends|male]], Jester had a height of 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] and had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], tan skin, and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Combat taught him the value of his blaster, and the self-disciplined soldier developed a habit of cleaning, scrubbing, and maintaining<ref name="TCWCE" /> his weapon after every battle. He was initially nervous about talking to his commanding officers, and at first stuttered while addressing Rex and Cody<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />&mdash;in his opinion, he would have rather faced a horde of battle droids than be subjected to an interrogation by his superior officers.<ref name="TCWCE" /> After Sketch vouched for him, he became more confident, offering evidence that Cody and Rex could verify themselves. Jester was visibly shocked when his own sergeant, Slick, was outed as the Confederate spy within the Republic's ranks.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> Besides maintaining his weapon, Jester kept his sideburns carefully tended. He was trained in combat, recon, and military tactics and was also proficient in handling heavy weapons like the [[Z-6 rotary blaster cannon/Legends|Z-6 rotary blaster cannon]].<ref name="TCWCE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jester first appeared in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''The Clone Wars'' webcomic]] [[The Clone Wars: Shadowed|''Shadowed'']], following which he was featured in "[[The Hidden Enemy]]," the episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|television series]]' [[2008]]&ndash;[[2009]] [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] that the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] led into. In the episode, he was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who provided the voice for all of the series' clone trooper characters.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy Ep Guide" /> Jester's model was later reused for clone trooper [[Pulsar (clone trooper)/Legends|Pulsar]] in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] episode "[[Brain Invaders]]."<ref name="Brain Invaders Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode208.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Brain Invaders}}</ref>
